1.explanation:
• MultiSelect/MultiSelect.mdx: the primary documentation showing the filterable MultiSelect example and its props (including how id and aria attributes are assembled).
• MultiSelect/README.md: background on component usage and accessibility guidelines that the Filterable variant should adhere to.
• ListBox/README.md: the underlying list structure and required ARIA roles (e.g., listbox→option), helping diagnose why options aren’t in a listbox.
• ComboBox/ComboBox.mdx: MultiSelect.Filterable is built on ComboBox behavior (aria-owns, aria-controls, roles), so review how it should set roles.
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx: the filter input’s id and role usage come from TextInput defaults, so we need to see how ids are generated and avoid duplication.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows the Filterable variant of the MultiSelect component rendered inside the Carbon React Storybook. At the top is a text-input field labeled “Filter,” which is actually wrapped in a <div> with role="button" and the same id as the underlying <input>. Below it is the expanded list of options (“Option 1”, “Option 2”, etc.), each rendered as <div role="option"> but not contained within an element with role="listbox". The DAP panel on the right reports: 1) duplicate id attribute (“carbon-multiselect-example” appears on both the wrapper <div> and the <input>), and 2) elements with role="option" not contained in a valid ARIA ancestor (role="listbox").
